newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open mixed Wednesday, as each of the metals in the complex was faced with challenging technical hurdles to leap.

COMEX December gold was called flat to $0.40 firmer from Tuesday's close of $383.40 an ounce after trading in a $383.90 to $383.40 range on ACCESS. COMEX gold warehouse stocks were down 401 ounces at 1,059,558 ounces Tuesday.
COMEX silver was called flat to up 1.0 cent after trading on ACCESS between $4.895 and $4.88.
In early New York inter-office trading, bullion was quoted at $382.45/95.
In London, bullion was fixed this morning at $382.50, up from the Tuesday afternoon fix of $381.90.
In London, silver was fixed at $4.90, off 0.50 cent from yesterday's fix.
COMEX silver stocks rose 1,928,011 ounces Tuesday to 135,184,954 ounces.
NYMEX January platinum was called $0.50 to $1.00 lower, with NYMEX December palladium called flat to $0.50 weaker.
October's U.S. producer prices are due at 0830 EST. A rise of 0.2 percent was forecast.
The Federal Open Market Committee meets in Washington.
